# Schautrack

> Schautrack is a self-hostable, open-source nutrition tracker for logging calories, macros, and weight; setting goals; and sharing progress.

## Product and API

- [Schautrack](https://schautrack.com/): hosted application and product overview.
- [Public API reference](https://schautrack.com/api/v1/docs): interactive documentation for the versioned REST API.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://schautrack.com/api/v1/openapi.json): machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 description of the public API.

## Documentation

- [Self-hosting guide](https://github.com/schaurian/schautrack#readme): Docker, Kubernetes, and configuration instructions.
- [API guide](https://github.com/schaurian/schautrack/blob/main/docs/api-v1.md): usage, authentication, scopes, and endpoint reference.
- [Architecture guide](https://github.com/schaurian/schautrack/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): system design, request pipeline, and the real-time (SSE) update flow.

## Source and support

- [Source repository](https://github.com/schaurian/schautrack): source code, issue tracker, and contribution information.
- [Releases](https://github.com/schaurian/schautrack/releases): release notes and published versions.
- [Android app source](https://github.com/schaurian/schautrack-android): Android companion application source code.
